customers.evidence: Leaders start with the customer and work backwards.

employees.evidence: Leaders have a vision for and commitment to their employees' personal success, whether that be at Amazon or elsewhere.

dei.evidence: They seek diverse perspectives and work to disconfirm their beliefs.

environment.evidence: Our local communities, planet, and future generations need us to be better every day.

community.evidence: Our local communities, planet, and future generations need us to be better every day.

shareholders.evidence: They think long term and don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

integrity.evidence: They are vocally self-critical, even when doing so is awkward or embarrassing.

safety.evidence: Leaders work every day to create a safer, more productive, higher performing, more diverse, and more just work environment.

innovation.evidence: Leaders expect and require innovation and invention from their teams and always find ways to simplify.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, third-person framing centred on Leaders and their principles, with customers and employees addressed first. Absolute, frequent language ('every day', 'never', 'always') with few hedges. First-person plural appears mainly in the closing section on responsibility. Distinctive wording includes 'Earth's Best Employer' and 'It is just one of the things that makes Amazon peculiar.'
